data.bottom_line: Triggering an avalanche has become unlikely. Still, finding unstable snow on an isolated terrain feature somewhere in the forecast area may not be impossible, especially in northerly-facing terrain above about 8,900 ft or in areas with signs of recent blowing snow. Evaluate conditions as you travel, and change your plans if you see signs of instability, such as cracking, collapsing, or feeling soft, loose snow near the base of the snowpack.
